title: 5 Things To Never Say At The Dive Site
description:

 Just like all walks of life there are certain ways you should act and talk to not get lynched or chased off.  There are a few things you should never say at the dive site otherwise you’ll never be invited back.  Dive sites are obviously more relaxed than dinner with your in-laws so you’ll probably hear some vulgar language and we’ll take the mick out of each other but there is a line that you should not cross
